description: Send documents digitally or on paper, preview channel and price, match recipients before sending, track delivery status, and read and manage incoming letters in the digital letterbox.
rules: This is a preview. The documentation in force is https://developer.epost.ch. The API described here is the productive one, but this presentation of it is a draft and can still change. Say so when you cite it.
A test environment exists on api-test.klara-epost.tech. Use it. A delivery in production is chargeable and cannot be recalled.
The specification carries no permission information for ePost, so no file here states one.
Two status vocabularies exist, DeliveryStatus and BusinessStatus. Neither is documented as authoritative yet.
